A uniform delta across exactly those three is a systematic positional shift in the rollout's own continuation, not noise.

The margin it lost was 0.45 points on a ~62-point scale (0.7%) -- a unique top by a hair. The human's own rationale agrees it is near-indifferent ('doesnt really make a difference'), which is the same shape as 85164605|1|decision|41, already held out to #145 as 'a NEAR-INDIFFERENT turn whose residual is a readiness-currency question'. If #189 concludes the gust marginal is not what moved here, #145 (`_readiness` and the currency audit) is the other candidate owner.

DETERMINISTIC, not #160's RNG: three independent process runs returned [64.75, 64.75, 64.75, 62.5, 60.025] identically, rank 4, tie 3.
